clean_source_blocks.text: The theme for 2026 Met Gala fundraiser is "Costume Art", exploring fashion as an embodied art form.

The first Monday in May has arrived, and all roads lead to the 2026 Met Gala. Tonight, stars of the fashion, music, and creative industries have gathered at the Metropolitan Museum of Art to celebrate the Costume Institute’s spring exhibition, “Costume Art.” Guiding the evening is the theme “Fashion Is Art,” a broad dress code that encourages attendees to treat the red carpet as a canvas—blurring the lines between fashion and fine art through bold, expressive looks.
The tennis star, 45, embraced the “Costume Art” theme on the red carpet for fashion’s biggest night on Monday, May 4, at The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York City.

As usual, the guest list is especially star-studded and is headlined by the gala’s co-chairs: Beyoncé, Nicole Kidman, Venus Williams, and Anna Wintour. The occasion marks Beyoncé’s first time attending fashion’s night out since the 2016 edition, celebrating “Manus x Machina: Fashion in an Age of Technology.” Also due on the red carpet is the host committee—chaired by Anthony Vaccarello and Zoë Kravitz—which includes the likes of Sabrina Carpenter, Lisa, Teyana Taylor, Alex Consani, Rebecca Hall, Paloma Elsesser, Misty Copeland, Jeff Bezos, Lauren Sánchez Bezos, and more stars.

original_article.research:
[Lähde: BBC World]
Celebrities are arriving to the 2026 Met Gala with their take on this year's theme -  Costume Art - where organisers asked attendees to experiment with the lavish and whimsical dress code.

The annual event is a fundraiser for the Metropolitan Museum of Art's Costume Institute, and serves as chance for celebrities and design houses to go all-out on spectacle.

The golden-voiced Broadway star Joshua Henry, took the drama up a notch by performing "I Wanna Dance With Somebody" with a band and dancers on the Met's iconic steps, which were outfitted to look like mossy bricks in a lush garden.

The guest list is especially starry this year, with the event's co-chairs including the musical multihyphenate Beyoncé, actress Nicole Kidman, tennis star Venus Williams, and Global Editorial Director of Vogue Anna Wintour.

Here's a look at some of the highlights. We will be updating with more looks throughout the night.

Anna Wintour, the Global Editorial Director of Vogue magazine, wore a feathery custom Chanel confection to her signature event.

Actress and event co-chair Nicole Kidman donned a red, long-sleeved beaded column gown by Chanel. She attended with her daughter, Sunday Rose.

American tennis star Venus Williams, a five-time Wimbledon winner, also co-chaired the event. She wore a black sparkling gown with a luxurious silver, jewel-encrusted neck adornment.

Lauren Sánchez Bezos, the wife of Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, is an honorary chair at this year's gala.

Her Schiaparelli gown invokes one of the most famous (and scandalous) dresses in art history: the gown portrayed John Singer Sargent's "Madame X".

"Ragtime" star Joshua Henry didn't just attend the red carpet. He opened the evening with a performance of Whitney Houston's "I Wanna Dance With Somebody", accompanied by dancers and a band.

Influencer Emma Chamberlian wore a multi-colored gown, courtesy of Mugler by Miguel Castro Freitas, that resembles a painting.

Philip is the first wheelchair user to attend the Met Gala, according to Vogue magazine.

"For so long, disabled people were not represented anywhere," Philip told Vogue. "The thought of even being able to exist at an event like this... nobody even went there. To go from that to now, somehow finding myself there - I can't say how blessed and honored I feel attending."

Delevingne's Ralph Lauren gown seemed simple from the front. But when she turned around, the dramatic sheer details had a vivid effect on the Met stairs.

Actress Chase Sui Wonde

[Lähde: TheWrap]
Celebrities, designers and industry power players have once again converged on the steps of the Metropolitan Museum of Art for the Met Gala, fashion’s biggest night and one of the most closely watched red carpets in the world.

Held on the first Monday in May, the annual benefit for the museum’s Costume Institute doubles as a global stage for spectacle, storytelling and high-concept design. This year’s “Costume Art” theme sets the tone for bold interpretations and boundary-pushing looks, with attendees translating the exhibit’s inspiration into custom couture, archival callbacks and viral-ready moments.

As always, the guest list blends A-list actors, chart-topping musicians, elite athletes and influential creators, all handpicked by industry icon Anna Wintour, currently Global Chief Content Officer of Condé Nast and Global Editorial Director of Vogue.

Scroll through the gallery below for every standout entrance — updated live as stars continue to arrive.

---

[Lähde: AOL]
Venus Williams served up a seriously stylish moment at the 2026 Met Gala.

The tennis star, 45, embraced the “Costume Art” theme on the red carpet for fashion’s biggest night on Monday, May 4, at The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York City.

Her sparkling black crystal mesh gown was inspired by Robert Pruitt’s portrait entitled Venus Williams, Double Portrait, commissioned by the National Portrait Gallery. The necklace, nearly identical to the one in the painting, takes after the Venus Rosewater Dish, awarded to the Ladies' singles winner each year at Wimbledon. Williams won the real thing herself five times during her career.

Venus attended the 2026 Met Gala as a cochair of the event — a role she shares with Nicole Kidman, Beyoncé and Anna Wintour. Venus is following in her sister Serena Williams’ footsteps ...

payload.title: Met-gaalan punaisella matolla korostui muoti taidemuotona
payload.summary: Vuoden 2026 Met-gaalan teemana on Costume Art, joka tarkastelee muotia kehollisena taidemuotona. New Yorkin Metropolitan Museum of Artissa järjestetty ilta kokosi yhteen muodin, musiikin ja luovien alojen tähtiä.
payload.content:
Vuoden 2026 Met-gaala järjestettiin maanantaina 4. toukokuuta New Yorkin Metropolitan Museum of Artissa, jossa illan teema Costume Art ohjasi vieraita tulkitsemaan muotia taiteena. Pukeutuminen nähtiin osana laajempaa visuaalista kokonaisuutta, jossa punainen matto toimi näyttämönä muodin, julkisuuden ja taideinstituution kohtaamiselle.

## Teema nosti vaatteen taideteokseksi

Tämänvuotinen gaala liittyy Costume Instituten kevätnäyttelyyn Costume Art. Teeman ytimessä on ajatus muodista kehollisena taidemuotona: vaate ei ole vain asu, vaan tapa rakentaa kuvaa, liikettä ja läsnäoloa ihmisen ympärille. Se antaa myös perustan sille, miksi tapahtuman punaisen maton hetkiä seurataan laajasti muoti- ja kulttuuripiireissä.

Illan pukeutumiskoodi Fashion Is Art antoi osallistujille väljät puitteet käsitellä punaista mattoa kuin taiteellista näyttämöä. Sen vuoksi huomio ei kohdistunut pelkästään yksittäisiin suunnittelijapukuihin, vaan siihen, miten asut rakensivat hahmoja, viittauksia ja tunnelmia. Gaalan luonteeseen kuuluu näyttävyys, mutta tämän vuoden teema teki siitä erityisen näkyvästi osan taiteen ja muodin rajankäyntiä.

## Tähtivieraat kokosivat huomion New Yorkiin

Gaalan puheenjohtajina toimivat Beyoncé, Nicole Kidman, Venus Williams ja Anna Wintour. Beyoncé palasi tapahtumaan ensimmäistä kertaa sitten vuoden 2016 Met-gaalan, jonka teemana oli Manus x Machina: Fashion in an Age of Technology. Paluu lisäsi iltaan yhden seuratuimmista julkisuushahmoista, vaikka packetin tiedot eivät eritelleet hänen asunsa yksityiskohtia.

Paikalle odotettiin myös laajaa isäntäkomiteaa, jota johtivat Anthony Vaccarello ja Zoë Kravitz. Mukana mainittiin muun muassa Sabrina Carpenter, Lisa, Teyana Taylor, Alex Consani, Rebecca Hall, Paloma Elsesser, Misty Copeland, Jeff Bezos ja Lauren Sánchez Bezos. Nimilista kertoo tapahtuman laajuudesta: gaala ei ole vain muotialan sisäinen tilaisuus, vaan myös musiikin, elokuvan, taiteen, liike-elämän ja populaarikulttuurin kohtaamispaikka.

## Punainen matto kehysti illan viestin

Yksi punaisella matolla huomioiduista vieraista oli 45-vuotias tennistähti Venus Williams, jonka kerrottiin tulkinneen Costume Art -teemaa illan pukeutumisessaan. Tarkempia asukohtaisia kuvauksia ei packetissa ollut, joten artikkeli ei arvioi yksittäisten pukujen materiaaleja, värejä tai suunnittelijoita.

Kokonaisuutena tapahtuma vahvisti Met-gaalan asemaa yhtenä muotivuoden näkyvimmistä hetkistä. Vuoden 2026 teema korosti erityisesti sitä, miten vaate voi toimia taiteellisena välineenä ja miten julkiset esiintymiset rakentavat merkityksiä punaisen maton kaltaisessa tarkasti seuratussa ympäristössä.
summary_bullets: Vuoden 2026 Met-gaalan teemana on Costume Art.
Tapahtuma järjestettiin Metropolitan Museum of Artissa New Yorkissa 4. toukokuuta.
Gaalan puheenjohtajina toimivat Beyoncé, Nicole Kidman, Venus Williams ja Anna Wintour.

article.source_text:
The theme for 2026 Met Gala fundraiser is "Costume Art", exploring fashion as an embodied art form.

The first Monday in May has arrived, and all roads lead to the 2026 Met Gala. Tonight, stars of the fashion, music, and creative industries have gathered at the Metropolitan Museum of Art to celebrate the Costume Institute’s spring exhibition, “Costume Art.” Guiding the evening is the theme “Fashion Is Art,” a broad dress code that encourages attendees to treat the red carpet as a canvas—blurring the lines between fashion and fine art through bold, expressive looks.

The tennis star, 45, embraced the “Costume Art” theme on the red carpet for fashion’s biggest night on Monday, May 4, at The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York City.

As usual, the guest list is especially star-studded and is headlined by the gala’s co-chairs: Beyoncé, Nicole Kidman, Venus Williams, and Anna Wintour. The occasion marks Beyoncé’s first time attending fashion’s night out since the 2016 edition, celebrating “Manus x Machina: Fashion in an Age of Technology.” Also due on the red carpet is the host committee—chaired by Anthony Vaccarello and Zoë Kravitz—which includes the likes of Sabrina Carpenter, Lisa, Teyana Taylor, Alex Consani, Rebecca Hall, Paloma Elsesser, Misty Copeland, Jeff Bezos, Lauren Sánchez Bezos, and more stars.
